title: Godot throw GPU validation errors when using 3D meshes with `--gpu-validation` on Vulkan
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible: 4.7 dev 5 and latest master - Not reproducible: 4.7 dev 4 ### System information Godot v4.7.dev5 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.8735) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory ### Issue description While investigating another issue, i found that using `--gpu-validation` and interacting with 3D meshes i receive a lot of validation errors. As pointed by blueskythlikesclouds [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/118719#issuecomment-4312020902) and confirmed by reverting the mentioned PR, this is a regression from #108219
GPU Validation Errors ``` ERROR: E:\Godot Dev\Godot Fork\drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:649 - VALIDATION - Message Id Number: -1670231826 | Message Id Name: VUID-vkCmdDrawIndexed-magFilter-04553  ERROR: vkCmdDrawIndexed(): the combined image sampler descriptor [VkDescriptorSet 0x31260000003126[RID:622521149816901], Set 0, Binding 19, Index 0] has VkSampler 0x920000000092[RID:188978561027] which is set to use VK_FILTER_LINEAR with compareEnable is set to VK_FALSE, but image view's (VkImageView 0x31240000003124[RID:622516854855329 View]) format (VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32_SFLOAT) does not contain VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_FILTER_LINEAR_BIT in its format features.  ERROR: The Vulkan spec states: If a VkSampler created with magFilter or minFilter equal to VK_FILTER_LINEAR, reductionMode equal to VK_SAMPLER_REDUCTION_MODE_WEIGHTED_AVERAGE, and compareEnable equal to VK_FALSE is used to sample a VkImageView as a result of this command, then the image view's format features must contain VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_FILTER_LINEAR_BIT (https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/drawing.html#VUID-vkCmdDrawIndexed-magFilter-04553)  ERROR: Objects -
